title: Specialist→requester handoff record (consultation-response)
description: Single JSONL record appended to .scratch/handoff.jsonl by the specialist who was consulted, answering a prior consultation-request. After this record is validated, the router (handoff.py route) returns control to the requesting specialist named in the corresponding request — not forward to the next pipeline stage. memory_updates lists any durable-memory writes that accompanied this consultation; usually empty when the answer points to existing memory.

type.description: Discriminator. Always "consultation-response" for this record type.

req_id.description: Requirement ID; must match the req_id of the corresponding consultation-request.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was appended.

author.description: The specialist answering. Must match the target of the corresponding consultation-request.

in_response_to.description: Line number (1-indexed) of the consultation-request this answers.

answer.description: The focused answer. References durable-memory sections where relevant.

memory_updates.description: Optional. Durable-memory writes that accompanied this consultation — patterns crystallized, ADRs created, ubiquitous-language entries added. Usually empty when the answer points to existing memory.

path.description: Relative path to the durable-memory file updated (for example, docs/system-design.md, docs/adr/2026-01-01-...md, docs/ubiquitous-language.md).

summary.description: One-line summary of what was added or changed.

notes.description: Free-form context that doesn't fit other fields. Avoid as a dumping ground.
